title: Imagined speech EEG dataset — long words condition (Nguyen et al. 2017)
description: EEG recordings from six healthy participants performing imagined speech of long words, comprising two word classes (cooperate and independent), with 64 channels recorded at 256 Hz. Trials were cued by auditory beeps and visual cues, and the data were analyzed with Riemannian manifold covariance features and relevance vector machines for brain-computer interface classification. The dataset is re-hosted in BIDS format from the MOABB benchmark collection.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a BrainProducts ActiCHamp system at 256 Hz from 64 channels (60 EEG, 4 EOG) in a 10-20 montage. Participants performed imagined speech cued by five auditory beeps at a 1.4 s rhythm plus visual cues. Preprocessing included 8-70 Hz 5th-order Butterworth bandpass filtering, a 60 Hz notch filter, and adaptive EOG artifact removal. Each 5-second trial was split into three overlapping 2-second epochs.
